description: Marks committed or signed SAFEs as funded before the company was on Lovie, for money that moved before any bank account here could show it. The company's word is the evidence, backed by the signed SAFE agreement on file: a SAFE is marked only when its investor has a signed or completed SAFE agreement with its document stored (and, when that agreement states a purchase amount, the same amount), and each such agreement backs at most one of that investor's SAFEs: one stating the SAFE's amount first, else one stating none. Pass dry_run=true to see which SAFEs would be marked without writing anything, for example to list them for the user before confirming. Each marked SAFE gets an opening-balance wire_received ledger entry for its committed amount, referenced 'Funded before Lovie - attested with the signed SAFE' so it is never mistaken for a reconciled bank wire, and it joins the cap table. Pass security_ids to mark named SAFEs, OR all_created_before_wire_rule=true to mark every eligible SAFE recorded before 2026-11-06 (when the cap table began showing a SAFE only once wired); never both. funded_date is optional and defaults to each SAFE's signed date; never invent one. Use this ONLY when the user confirms the money arrived before the company used Lovie. A SAFE funded since then is recorded with RecordCapTableWire against a matched bank transaction or a verified payment proof. Always confirm with the user before calling, listing the SAFEs and amounts; afterwards report every outcome, including each skipped SAFE and its skipped_reason (no_signed_agreement means upload the signed SAFE with ImportSAFE first).
name: cap_table_mark_cap_table_safes_funded_before_lovie
title: Mark Cap Table Safes Funded Before Lovie
